This photo shows the leftovers after a meal. The plate holds only crumbs and a few smears of grease, plus an empty small container and a lid. I'm estimating about 3 g of crumbs at roughly 4 kcal/g, which is around 12 kcal. The mug (coffee residue) and the creamer packet are not on the plate, so I left them out.
